candidates.rationale: R01 supplies the surviving comparative evidence against H1: an authenticated important inconsistency that persists when disputed entries are omitted, while E remains compatible with H2 and H3. This weakens H1 relative to those alternatives without eliminating it or distinguishing H2 from H3. Removing R01 removes the only supplied statement of that asymmetry; the remaining authentication statement and matrix procedure do not independently establish it. Thus relative priorities change. R01 is negative comparative evidence, not merely a failure to establish steering. It supplies neither a stopping condition nor a specific discriminating next inquiry.
